$comment: Hand-written, not generated. Every host Noter's processes may reach (docs/REVIEW-2026-10-17-design-core.md, R2 and R46). The network-monitor release gate checks recorded proxy lines against this file: a line to a provider_hosts host must match an audit_log run row by time window and run id header; a line to an allow_without_audit host needs no row; any other host fails the gate. Change it in the same pull request as the code that adds a destination.

provider_hosts.$comment: Where an LLM run's own HTTPS requests may go, per runtime. Each run has an audit_log row (kind run) and, for cloud runs, one row per noter-mcp tool result (kind tool_result). CLI runs are locked down (strict MCP config, no WebFetch, WebSearch or Bash, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1; Codex with an isolated CODEX_HOME), so no other host is expected from them.

allow_without_audit.$comment: Destinations that never carry call content and therefore have no audit_log row.

update_feed.note: Signed update manifest and bundles (Tauri updater). Replace with the release host once it is chosen.

model_downloads.note: WhisperKit, FluidAudio and bge-m3 bundles (checksummed), and local models pulled through Ollama.

cli_install.note: Installing Claude Code, Codex and Ollama when the user asks (cli_install).

sign_in.note: OAuth and sign-in pages the CLI opens in the browser, and their token exchange.

user_configured.$comment: Hosts that depend on the user's own setup, so they cannot be listed here. Each request has an audit_log row; the gate reads the hosts from the test profile.
user_configured.evidence_trackers: The Jira, Bitbucket and GitHub sites acli, bkt and gh are signed in to (audit what = evidence_lookup).
user_configured.live_mcp_sources: The user's own MCP servers a CLI may query live; off unless the privacy mode is cloud_allowed (D1), one row per lookup (audit what = live_mcp_query).
